verdict.rationale: Runloop's first-party snapshot docs say snapshots save a Devbox's disk state and create new Devboxes from it. They name rollback to a known good point and fan-out to attempt multiple approaches, which covers both restore and fork, and describe snapshots as 'saved diskstates... for re-use & branching'. Snapshots also appear in the SDK coverage list. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and detail on memory/process-state capture (docs specify disk state only).
